title: Night-Time Wandering Watch
dataSources: Daily activity (`eldercare:activity`), fall alerts (`fall:alert`), medication reminders (`medreminder:event`), check-in calls (`checkin:call`), wandering alerts (`wandering:alert`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — activity and fall sensors (Apple Watch fall detection, motion mats), medication dispensers, and check-in / video-call logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and smart-home hubs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wandering:alert
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| where hour>=23 OR hour<=5
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as night_events, values(location) as places by _time
| sort - _time
description: Flags night-time movement toward doors or outside that can indicate wandering, a serious risk for people with dementia.
value: Early alerts on night wandering can prevent a loved one leaving the house unsafely in the dark.
implementation: Ingest door and motion alerts into `index=personal`; isolate overnight events and summarise per night.
visualization: Table of night-time wandering events by night.
grandmaExplanation: It watches for someone moving about or heading for the door in the middle of the night, so you can keep them safe.
